title: Fundamental Rights — complete subject set (Part III)

content.description: Subject working set for Indian Fundamental Rights: Part III scheme, Arts 12–13, equality (14–18), freedoms (19), life/liberty/education/arrest (20–22, 21A), exploitation (23–24), religion (25–28), cultural/educational rights (29–30), historical property (31/31A–C/300A), constitutional remedies (32), and Arts 33–35. Reuses canonical constitution-art-* entities via topic relationships; see also collection:india:constitution-part-iii.
